g.text: Loop inside recursion: Tries out all
# base case: check if solution is complete
The "undo(option)" happens inside the loop to reset
- Invalid branches are cut early with a
- Saves time as compared to brute force
- Ex: In N-Queens, if queens threaten
each other, don't continue that branch
- undo(option) = Take the choice back before trying another path
Pattern: Try -> Check -> Recurse -> Undo -> Next Option
